test_SpecManager_pack: test the SpecManager pack method to convert name-keyed dicts to UID-keyed dm_env_rpc tensors
test_SpecManager_unpack: test the SpecManager unpack method to convert UID-keyed dm_env_rpc tensors to name-keyed dicts
test_SpecManager_name_to_uid: test the SpecManager name_to_uid method to resolve a tensor spec name to its UID
test_SpecManager_variable_shape: test the SpecManager pack method with variable shape specs using -1 dimensions
test_SpecManager_constructor: test the SpecManager constructor to detect duplicate names and invalid multi-variable shapes
